title: Canvas and SVG
description: A drawing pad, a bar chart and a target game drawn on canvas, and an SVG map with hover tooltips, where what is shown cannot be found with normal DOM queries.

pad.title: Drawing pad
pad.intro: Hold the mouse button down and move to draw. Each line you draw is a stroke.
pad.label: Drawing pad

chart.title: Orders chart
chart.intro: Click a bar to see how many orders there were that month.
chart.label: Bar chart of orders per month, January to June
chart.none: Click a bar to see its value.

game.title: Target practice
game.intro: Click the target. Each time you hit it, it moves.
game.label: Target game

map.title: District map
map.intro: Point at a district to see its population, and click it to select it.
map.label: Map of the districts of the island
